proves.claim: a set affectedTests is never overwritten when the package names jest.

cli.logic-init-affected-default.other-ru.why: Without it init could replace a runner the person already chose.

proves.claim: init in a jest project writes no affectedTests key.

cli.io-init-affected-runner.jest-project.why: Without it the real init path could still write node --test for a non-node:test project.

proves.claim: init in a node --test project still writes affectedTests node --test.

cli.io-init-affected-runner.node-test-pr.why: Without it the fix could drop the default for projects that do use node:test.

proves.claim: a plain node --test script, with or without flags, sets affectedTests node --test.

cli.logic-init-affected-default.plain-no.why: Without it a real node:test project loses the per-file runner init used to give it.

proves.claim: jest, bun, tsx, c8, npm run chains, custom scripts and a missing test script leave affectedTests unset.

cli.logic-init-affected-default.non-plai.why: Without it init writes node --test for a project whose files need another runner and the proof goes red.
